label: OpenRouter Decision Model
description: Pick an OpenRouter decision model, on the connection an OpenRouter Access node holds, and wire its provider into the decision nodes (Decide: Pick One, Yes or No, Score, Find in Image), one model node for however many of them. A decision model answers a typed question about what it is given with probabilities, never text: use it for routing, classifying, moderating, gating and scoring, where an LLM would be asked a narrow question and its answer parsed. Models differ in what they read (text only, images, audio and video on cloudflare/clef-omni) and in their probabilities on the same question, so a threshold set on one model is set again on another.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: The OpenRouter connection: wire an OpenRouter Access node's `access`.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A versioned id rather than an alias (`~typesafe/jev-latest`): an alias moves to a new release, and the probabilities your thresholds were set on move with it.

inputs.name: servingProvider
inputs.label: Serving provider
inputs.description: Serve the model from one specific OpenRouter provider. Leave empty to let OpenRouter route.

inputs.name: providerFallbacks
inputs.label: Allow provider fallbacks
inputs.description: Fall back to other serving providers when the preferred one is unavailable. Off makes the call fail rather than be served and billed by someone else.

outputs.name: provider
outputs.description: Wire it into a decision node's provider input.

then.message: OpenRouterDecisionModel '{id}' has no model; name one on the node or wire one in.
